scope: Source-backed research and proposed cards only. No runtime adoption, image generation, paid calls, commits or pushes.

sources.title: SFE: Space Opera
sources.read_scope: Entry body lines 23-59; historical development and later examples.
supports: Term shifted from pejorative pulp label toward colourful interstellar adventure; romantic scale and sense of wonder recur.
Modern examples include political, literary, comedic and optimistic variants.
limits: Critical reference entry; not a mandatory visual style definition.
No fixed palette, ship design, war or monarchy follows from the genre label.

sources.title: SFE: Galactic Empires
sources.read_scope: Entry body lines 23-40.
supports: Empire can function as a broad galactic framework rather than a precise autocratic government.
Historical analogies and league/federation variants require separate political interpretation.
limits: Historical genre criticism, not a taxonomy of every fictional government.
A throne, uniform or enormous city does not establish a complete political system.

sources.title: SFE: First Contact
sources.read_scope: Entry body lines 23-36.
supports: Contact concerns communication, interpretation and mutual suspicion; outcomes include aid, incomprehension and indirect contact through artifacts.
limits: Firstness and successful understanding are narrative/time claims.
Humanoid aliens facing humans are insufficient evidence of first contact.

sources.title: Star Wars Databank: Galactic Empire
sources.read_scope: Main definition line 31; related Tarkin/Death Star summaries lines 190-205.
supports: This specific Empire uses intimidation, military force and surveillance.
The named Death Star is a planet-destroying station; Tarkin's summary ties its use to Alderaan and political fear.
limits: Franchise-specific account, not all empires or space opera.
Read text; did not verify film frames or gallery pixels.
No blanket equivalence between intimidation, military occupation and a particular legal offense.

sources.title: Star Trek: Get To Know
sources.read_scope: Intro lines 15-19 and warp/Starfleet/missions sections lines 187-201.
supports: Federation is described as an interstellar republic; Starfleet has scientific, diplomatic, humanitarian and defensive functions.
Prime Directive is a named noninterference doctrine in this setting.
limits: Promotional primer simplifies exceptions and historical changes.
Prime Directive is not a synonym for all diplomatic restraint or all utopias.

sources.title: Star Trek: Galactic Politics — The Federation and the Dominion
sources.read_scope: Official editorial body lines 42-69.
supports: Elected representation and voluntary membership contrast with controlled subject worlds, enforcement and expansion.
Diplomacy can coexist with coercion, manipulation or military action.
limits: Author commentary on specific fictional powers.
Equal seating or mixed species do not prove voluntary accession, elections or actual equality.

sources.title: Star Trek: The Measure of a Man Demonstrates the Many Forms of Love
sources.read_scope: Official retrospective lines 58-84, including hearing description.
supports: Data's status as person versus property and autonomy under proposed experimental refit form the dispute.
A detachable mechanical hand can be used as tribunal evidence without settling personhood.
limits: Interpretive retrospective, not episode transcript or current AI law.
Mechanical embodiment, intelligence, sentience, legal personhood and moral worth remain separate fields.

sources.title: Penguin Random House: Dune Series
sources.read_scope: Publisher synopses for Chapterhouse, Heretics, God Emperor, Children, Messiah and Dune; lines 169-267.
supports: Noble houses, dynastic power, desert resource value, production control, religious charisma and prophecy intersect.
The series changes political/ecological conditions over time.
limits: Publisher summaries only; no claim to have read the novels or proprietary full text.
Synopsis does not establish detailed Spacing Guild navigation mechanics, CHOAM shares or all feudal institutions.
Young protagonists in synopsis are not adult-scene authorization.

sources.title: Orbit: Ancillary Justice
sources.read_scope: Publisher Description lines 99-106; no paid excerpt.
supports: Breq formerly existed as a warship AI linked to many soldiers and is now limited to one human body.
Collective embodiment and current single-body appearance differ.
limits: Book synopsis only, not complete narrative or annexation-system mechanics.
One human-looking body cannot visually establish former ship identity or distributed consciousness.

sources.title: Macmillan: A Memory Called Empire
sources.read_scope: Legally public chapter 1 excerpt lines 31-54, especially imago definition/host control lines 43-48.
supports: An implanted predecessor-memory and a living host have distinct histories and potentially competing control.
The public excerpt explicitly treats host consent as relevant to control of the nervous system.
Empire can attract through language, urban scale and culture as well as force.
limits: Only the supplied chapter excerpt read; not whole book.
Implant pixels cannot demonstrate memory continuity, authenticity, integration or valid consent.

sources.title: Iain Banks: In conversation with David Conyers, Albedo 2011
sources.read_scope: Author interview opening answer, lines 77-78.
supports: Banks describes the Culture as a post-scarcity human/machine civilization.
Drones have equal rights; Minds are generally embodied within ships; Orbitals are inhabited structures.
Intervention and moral self-justification are narrative issues.
limits: Author's 2011 overview; no complete book or final-series canon survey.
Minds is Culture terminology; shipmind is a broader reusable concept.
No source support here for detailed Glanding procedures.

sources.title: Orbit: Revelation Space
sources.read_scope: Publisher Description lines 112-118.
supports: An ancient destroyed civilization, archaeological mystery and cyborg starship crew connect immense time scales with present risk.
limits: Synopsis only.
Does not document all lighthugger engineering, specific nanotechnologies or proof of any real Fermi solution.

sources.title: James S. A. Corey: Leviathan Wakes
sources.read_scope: Author-site book synopsis lines 33-38.
supports: Solar-system settlement and civil-war-scale political mystery can support space-opera adventure without a galaxy-wide empire.
limits: Synopsis only; no detailed Epstein Drive, Belter physiology or protomolecule mechanism read.
Novel and television production motifs are not interchangeable by default.

sources.title: Haikasoru / Simon & Schuster: Legend of the Galactic Heroes, Vol. 1
sources.read_scope: About the Book lines 243-247.
supports: A Prussian-model Galactic Empire and democratic Free Planets Alliance are rival political institutions.
Leaders' ideals and institutional structures can conflict; moral judgments cannot be read directly from uniform style.
limits: English publisher synopsis only, not novel/anime read.
Specific costumes, fleet formations and adaptation designs require separate visual sources.

sources.title: Image Comics: Saga 6x9 editions announcement
sources.read_scope: Official press release lines 24-29.
supports: Star-crossed lovers from enemy worlds become parents protecting a child during galactic war.
Domestic kinship and care can carry large-scale conflict.
limits: Publisher synopsis only; no full issues or art sequence read.
Mature-reader marketing does not establish every depicted character's age or consent.

sources.title: Star Trek: Everything You Need to Know About the Borg Queen
sources.read_scope: Official editorial lines 46-74.
supports: Borg combine organic and synthetic matter, collective network links, assimilation and suppression of individuality.
The Queen is discussed through host succession and collective direction.
limits: Specific editorial overview, not universal hive-mind definition; later stories and factions may differ.
Visible implants do not prove assimilation, nonconsent or loss of agency.
Do not copy the article's blanket statements to all drones, cyborgs or AI societies.

sources.title: Star Trek: The Enduring Legacy of Amok Time
sources.read_scope: Official feature lines 48-76; original Vulcan premise and later trope adaptation discussion.
supports: Pon Farr is a named Vulcan biological/ritual premise; later mate-or-die adaptations alter the framing.
Original episode discussion includes a refused marriage ritual and a combat challenge.
limits: Official critical feature, not biological fact or complete species guide.
Biological urgency does not establish another person's willingness or valid consent.
Do not equate Pon Farr with every pheromone trope, libido increase or compulsory sexual act.

sources.title: Warhammer Community: The Octarius Sector is Hell and It’s All Inquisitor Kryptman’s Fault
sources.read_scope: Official lore text lines 271-284, especially Exterminatus paragraph 275-279.
supports: Kryptman orders Exterminatus along a threatened route, condemning billions; strategic purpose does not erase victims.
The term denotes an in-setting sanction/order/event context.
limits: This article does not supply a universal weapon mechanism or require literal planet fragmentation.
No general legal definition of genocide, crimes against humanity or war crimes is established.
Gallery pixels were not inspected.

sources.title: UNFPA: Five things you need to know about consent
sources.read_scope: Sections 1 and 3, lines 28-35 and 42-48; body overview to line 61.
supports: Bodily autonomy covers choices about one's body, partner, health care and reproduction.
Integrity, agency, unequal power and material dependence matter beyond outward appearance.
limits: Human-rights explanatory source, not jurisdiction-specific legal advice or a full clinical protocol.
Does not specify a visual test for adulthood or consent.
No current numerical claims are reused from the dated article.

sources.title: Warhammer Community: Warhammer art through the years — Adeptus Mechanicus
sources.read_scope: Official text introduction lines 272-273; gallery list only.
supports: Adeptus Mechanicus join technological custodianship with Machine God worship, sanctification rituals and extensive augmentation.
limits: Franchise-specific order, not all machine cults, cyborgs or maintenance practices.
No artwork pixels or complete visual catalog were inspected.
Crimson, skulls, cogs and named insignia are optional franchise cues, not necessary features of generic machine religion.

cards.title: 궤도 봉쇄 아래 최후통첩 / Orbital ultimatum
visible_components: 탁자 한쪽의 통치권 대리인과 맞은편 지역 대표
지역 대표 뒤 창밖을 막는 군함
두 대표 사이에 놓인 항로 지도와 봉인된 요구 문서
문서로 향하는 대리인의 손과 이를 바라보는 지역 대표
render_gates: 위협 함대와 차단된 출구가 같은 프레임에서 구별됨
성인 대표들의 지위는 요청 메타데이터에 명시
cards.activation: Empire label alone is context. Blockade and ultimatum require explicit request evidence.

cards.title: 가입을 심의하는 다종 연방 / Federation accession hearing
visible_components: 여러 종의 성인 대표가 사용하는 개별 좌석과 발언 장치
한 대표가 양손으로 받치는 가입 청원서
중앙 공유 지도와 균등하게 배치된 의석
참관 구역에서 공개 심의를 바라보는 방문 대표단
render_gates: 서로 다른 좌석·대표·발언 장치의 소유 관계
모든 종을 동일한 인간 체형으로 평준화하지 않음
cards.activation: Federation supports political context; no automatic specific uniform, Prime Directive or optimism palette.

cards.title: 성인 왕조 당사자의 동맹 계약 / Adult dynastic alliance
visible_components: 성인 두 당사자 앞의 서로 다른 가문 인장
동맹 조약과 별도의 행성 영지 문서
당사자 한 사람이 조약의 한 조항을 가리키고 중재인이 기다리는 순간
한 가문의 대표가 영지 지도 인장을 보유
render_gates: 성인 여부·관계 유형·동의 범위는 입력 맥락으로 고정
문서 두 종류를 하나로 합치지 않음
cards.activation: Dynastic marriage, forced marriage and incest are distinct context routes; wedding imagery does not activate the others.

cards.title: 단일 수출 허가를 둘러싼 자원 갈등 / Resource bottleneck
visible_components: 희귀 원료 채취 설비에서 밀폐 화물로 이어지는 컨베이어
단 하나의 출하 게이트를 지키는 허가 담당자
허가를 기다리는 두 상인의 빈 운송기
지역 노동자와 수입업자의 서로 다른 표식
confusion_negatives: 밀수 장면과 공식 출하 장면 혼동
cards.activation: Generic rare resource stays unnamed. Dune-specific spice mechanisms require scoped canon sources.

cards.title: 서로 다른 환경 사이의 접촉 중재 / Mediated contact
visible_components: 서로 다른 대기 환경을 나누는 투명 격벽
양쪽 성인 대표의 서로 다른 해부 구조에 맞춘 작업대
같은 실물 표본을 가리키는 두 표현 체계
각 진영 소유의 번역 장치와 관찰 창
confusion_negatives: 기계 번역이 완벽한 이해를 보장한다는 해석
render_gates: alien=괴물 또는 인간의 적으로 자동 변환하지 않음
cards.activation: First contact remains narrative context; visible mediation is a separately testable realization.

cards.title: 안드로이드의 자율성을 다투는 심의 / Android autonomy hearing
visible_components: 성인형 안드로이드 당사자
당사자의 손과 분리된 동형 기계 손을 전시하는 증거대
심의자·대리인·당사자의 분리된 좌석
당사자가 직접 보유한 신원 기록과 실험 동의서
confusion_negatives: 기계 부품이 있다는 이유로 재산임을 확정
render_gates: Data의 외모나 Starfleet 의장을 일반 안드로이드에 강제하지 않음
cards.activation: Personhood is context/adjudication. Visible mechanical structure must match android rather than cyborg.

cards.title: 함선 지성과 승무원의 공동 의사결정 / Shipmind consultation
visible_components: 함선 내부에 물리적으로 설치된 다중 연산 노드
함선 노드에서 공유 화면으로 이어지는 가시적 회선
다른 위치의 두 단말이 같은 의제를 표시
자기 작업대에서 응답하는 성인 승무원
confusion_negatives: Borg식 강제 동화를 모든 공유망에 적용
render_gates: 배의 구성요소와 인간 신체를 분리해 소유자 결합
cards.activation: Topology and agency are separate. Networks do not imply coercion or rights.

cards.title: 기억 이식의 중단권을 가진 숙주 / Host-controlled memory interface
visible_components: 성인 숙주의 목 뒤에 부착된 인터페이스
숙주 손이 직접 쥔 분리 스위치
전임자의 기록을 띄우는 별도 단말
접속이 끊어진 케이블을 들고 기다리는 기술자
confusion_negatives: 숙주의 수동적 표정이 동의를 의미한다는 추론
cards.activation: Visual proxy for available control, not proof of valid consent; mind fork/clone/upload routes stay distinct.

cards.title: 엔진을 성물로 다루는 기계 종교 / Engine sanctification
visible_components: 우주선 엔진을 둘러싼 의례적 작업 공간
정비 도구와 분리된 향로·봉헌문
엔진 접속부에 도구를 맞대는 증강 성직자
주변 신도가 바라보는 특정 성물·장치
confusion_negatives: 향 연기를 실제 신령·전기 기능의 증거로 취급
render_gates: 정비 도구와 의례 물건의 기능·소유 구별
cards.activation: Generic ritual/maintenance relation is reusable; faction names, cog-skull symbols and Martian red are opt-in.

cards.title: 전쟁 속 돌봄을 나누는 성인 가족 / Adult caregivers in transit
visible_components: 서로 다른 종의 성인 보호자 두 명
한 보호자가 지지하는 아동용 구조 캡슐
다른 보호자가 받쳐 든 필수 보급품
뒤쪽 검문소와 앞쪽 민간 대피 통로
confusion_negatives: 혼종 외형으로 생물학적 친자 관계 확정
render_gates: 아동 돌봄과 성인 관계 맥락을 분리
cards.activation: Domestic care is independent of sexual relationship graph; nonsexual scene only.

cards.title: 생물학적 위기에서 선택권을 지키는 치료실 / Autonomy during a biological crisis
visible_components: 괴로운 표정의 성인 환자가 앉은 비구속적 치료 의자
의료진이 환자에게 보여주는 투약 선택 패널
환자 손 가까이 놓인 호출·중단 장치
방문자가 머무는 분리된 대기 구역
confusion_negatives: 의학적 응급을 다른 사람의 성적 의무로 전환
Pon Farr/pheromone/mate-or-die를 동일 생리 현상으로 병합
single_still_cannot_prove: Pon Farr 또는 가상 호르몬의 실제 발병
미래 사망 위험이나 특정 치료의 필수성
render_gates: 임의 성적 행위·페로몬 시각 효과 삽입 금지
cards.activation: Named biological condition routes to context and care/choice alternatives; it never supplies sexual consent.

cards.title: 행성 파괴 명령과 피해의 거리 / Planetary devastation accountability
visible_components: 불타는 대륙이 보이되 구체 형태를 유지하는 행성
행성 앞쪽의 작은 민간 대피선
함교에서 명령문을 들여다보는 성인 지휘관
별도 화면에 표시된 출항하지 못한 항구
single_still_cannot_prove: 명령의 진위·책임·특정 집단 파괴 의도·법적 범죄 분류
render_gates: 원형 유지/표면 피해/물리적 파편화의 의도된 결과 구분
Exterminatus를 요구하지 않은 장면에 해당 작품 도상 삽입 금지
cards.activation: Named sanction, weapon mechanism, physical damage and ethical/legal classification require separate fields.
